flags.estimate: 30 (literal kit pellets); alternative 3 if the engine counts trigger pulls
flags.reasoning: The kit states 30 PELLETS, and this unit is a 10-pellet SG (hitsPerShot 10), so 30 pellets = 3 full-landing shots. The engine's hitCount is documented as counting ROUNDS not pulls, with hitsPerShot expansion called out explicitly only for MG. Whether an SG shot contributes 1 or 10 to the hit counter is outside the input domain of the kit text, and the two readings differ by 10x in proc rate for BOTH the 202.84% rider and the in-FB ATK stack engine.
flags.recipe: Run controlComp('privaty-unkind-maid') with cfg.onEvent, count shot events vs flatDamage(202.84) damage events over the 180s fight. If the rider fires ~once per 3 shots, the counter is per-pellet and count:30 is correct; if ~once per 30 shots, rewrite both counts to 3.

flags.field: skill2[0].trigger (the '5 or more pellets hit' gate)
flags.estimate: modeled unconditional on every shotFired (gate assumed always satisfied)
flags.reasoning: No schema primitive expresses a per-shot landed-pellet threshold. At the scope-lock boss's near band an SG lands the majority of its 10 pellets, so ≥5 is usually true; at range or off-crosshair it is not. Modeling it unconditionally is the optimistic bound and over-credits reload uptime whenever landing drops below 5/10.
flags.recipe: Read landed pellets/shot from the pellet reader (docs/probe-data SG landing fractions) or a recorded fight for this unit; if the landing fraction sits below 5/10 for a material part of the fight, either derate the buff value by the satisfied fraction or add an engine-side landed-pellet gate.

flags.reasoning: 'Reload 1 round(s)' is an absolute round count; instantReload takes a FRACTION of max capacity. 1/9 is exact only at the datamined base ammo 9 — any maxAmmoPct/maxAmmoFlat source in the comp makes the fraction refund more than one round.
flags.recipe: Assert in scripts/tests/units/privaty-unkind-maid.test.ts that a reload event after the in-FB proc restores exactly 1 round with a maxAmmo-buffing ally present; if it over-refunds, the engine needs a flat-round refill primitive.

flags.field: base cadence tuple (SG rate_of_fire, reloadFrames 141, ammo 9)
flags.reasoning: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the game fires on 60fps frame boundaries so the effective rate is 60/ceil(60/nominal). This unit's ENTIRE proc economy (both 30-pellet counters, the reload-speed buff's payoff, the in-FB ATK stack uptime) is downstream of that tuple, so a small cadence error compounds.
flags.recipe: Measure shots/sec and reload wall-clock directly off a recording's ammo counter (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), not off full-burst counts, and pin as a fixture.

flags.estimate: authored per-stack at maxStacks 5, no rampSec haircut
flags.reasoning: The 2s duration is short relative to a 9-round SG magazine plus a 141-frame reload, so stacks likely decay between procs rather than sitting at the 56.1% cap; but the accrual is driven entirely by the unresolved pellet-vs-pull counter above, so a ramp haircut cannot be derived without that answer. Authoring per-stack lets the engine compute the real trajectory rather than baking in a guess.
flags.recipe: After resolving the counter semantics, log buffApply {stat:'atkPct'} events and integrate stacks×time over the fight; if mean stacks sit well below 5 the value is already correct (engine-computed), if the engine instead holds at cap unrealistically add rampSec or shorten via measurement.
